title: Oscillations waves and optics
prerequisites: P1, M2, M5 basics; P2 helpful.
purpose: Analyze superposition, normal modes and propagation to prepare for quantum wave mechanics.
primary_reading: MIT 8.03SC Physics III Vibrations and Waves

blocks.deliverable: Fit an exponential envelope and interpret parameters.
Solve a two oscillator eigenvalue problem.
Check that a proposed wave solves its equation.
Week 7 midterm; compare fixed and free boundaries.
Reconstruct a pulse from modes and observe spreading.
Predict fringes and state approximation limits.
Present the simulation and complete an unseen waves final.

project: Simulate coupled oscillators and explain the relationship between normal modes and beats.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
